inlines.v: NEGLIGENT, adjective 1. Careless; heedless; apt or accustomed to omit what ought to be done; inattentive to business or necessary concerns. It is applied to a particular instance of neglect, or it denotes habitually careless or inattentive. 2 Chronicles 29:11. 2 Peter 1:12. He that thinks he can afford to be negligent is not far from being poor. 2. Regardless. Be thou negligent of fame.
